title: ANPD regulatory process on artificial intelligence and review of automated decisions (LGPD Art. 20)
title_original: Tomada de Subsídios sobre Inteligência Artificial e revisão de decisões automatizadas
summary: Regulatory process by Brazil's data protection authority (ANPD) on how the LGPD applies to AI, centred on the Article 20 right to review automated decisions. The ANPD opened a public call for input (tomada de subsídios) on the Participa+Brasil platform on 6 November 2024, with 15 questions on principles, legal bases, data subject rights and governance; the deadline was extended to 24 January 2025. Technical Note No. 12/2025 (May 2025) consolidated the input. The topic sits as item 7 of the ANPD Regulatory Agenda 2025-2026; no draft rule or guide had been published as of October 2026.
